notes.title: Devlog 3: Recall - Revisiting the Truth
notes.content:
[h3][b]Private Eye: The Young Heir - A Deep Dive into Detective Fantasy[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/5f475bccce11cc404c807ba1bee64060f6ae8c31.png[/img]

At Lucky 7 Studios, we’re crafting a detective game that goes beyond conventional mystery-solving mechanics. With Private Eye: The Young Heir, our aim is to immerse players fully into the role of a sleuth, giving them innovative tools to unravel a complex narrative. One of the most groundbreaking features in our game is the Recall mechanic—a system that blends dialogue, exploration, and deduction into a seamless investigative experience.

[h3][b]Gameplay Focus: The Recall Mechanic[/b][/h3]
The Recall feature allows players to step into the past—literally. As Hakeem questions suspects, he gathers testimonies that paint a vivid picture of past events. Once he has enough information, he can activate a Recall to revisit the scene described by the suspect and investigate it firsthand. This mechanic transforms testimonies from mere words into interactive experiences, enabling players to directly engage with the events as described.

[h3][b]Reliving the Scene[/b][/h3]
Imagine questioning a nervous maid about the events of a stormy night. She hesitantly describes hearing a crash in the study, followed by hurried footsteps. With Recall, you’re no longer relying solely on her account. Instead, you’re transported to that very study, experiencing the moment through her words. You can inspect the crash site, interact with objects, and uncover details she might have missed—or conveniently omitted.
This mechanic ensures that players aren’t just passive recipients of information but active participants in validating and expanding upon testimonies. It’s about empowering players to take control of the investigation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/8938878b6fba76485b3957f0dec2657ba4d2b98b.gif[/img]

[h3][b]The Power of Cross-Examination[/b][/h3]
The Recall feature truly shines when testimonies collide. In Private Eye: The Young Heir, no mystery is one-sided. Different characters provide conflicting accounts of the same events. Once you’ve collected Recalls from multiple suspects, you can cross-examine them, juxtaposing the scenes to spot inconsistencies or outright lies.
For example, the maid claims the room was dark during the crash, but a Recall from the butler reveals a lit lamp at the same time. Such discrepancies push players to question motives and seek the truth hidden beneath layers of deceit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106591/81f3762dd95b827ba38947d5f73837b554f6b04a.gif[/img]
[h3][b]Building the Case with Recall[/b][/h3]
The Recall mechanic isn’t just about verifying testimonies—it’s about understanding the characters and their motivations. By stepping into the shoes of witnesses, players gain insight into their personalities, fears, and secrets. Every detail matters, from the angle of a fallen vase to the position of a suspicious footprint.
This feature also deepens the emotional weight of the narrative. Witnessing a suspect’s version of events helps players empathize—or grow suspicious. It’s a delicate balance that keeps players engaged, challenging them to piece together the puzzle of who can be trusted and who is hiding the truth.

[h3][b]The Detective Fantasy Comes to Life[/b][/h3]
With the Recall feature, Private Eye: The Young Heir delivers a detective experience like no other. By allowing players to relive and scrutinize testimonies, we’ve created a mechanic that combines narrative depth, environmental exploration, and logical deduction into one cohesive system.
Every Recall brings players closer to the truth—or deeper into the web of lies. It’s up to you, the detective, to decide who’s telling the truth and who’s manipulating the past to cover their tracks.
This is detective fantasy redefined, and we can’t wait for you to experience it.

[b]Stay tuned for the next dev log as we explore another feature designed to make Private Eye: The Young Heir the ultimate detective adventure.
[/b]
